summary: Comprehensive testing of Digital Mate security MVP. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass on /api/security/* (telemetry training, deterministic Gaussian scoring, trap auto-activation, intruder events, lock/unlock/wipe guards, location, trap deactivate code-protected). Frontend: mobile (390x844) flows verified — Launch via 'Try the Demo →' lands on Security Dashboard, bottom nav (home/recovery/evidence/mate) works, Owner Recognition trains baseline and displays signal breakdown, Recovery Center performs remote lock (shows Lost Mode), unlock with owner code 15987, 2-step wipe flow (code -> next -> confirm), Evidence Center renders empty state correctly, AI Mate chat loads, Invisible Vault dialer accepts 8675309 and transitions to Calculator decoy vault.

issues: The 'Made with Emergent' badge (id=emergent-badge) sits at the bottom of the viewport and overlaps the fixed bottom-nav buttons (nav-evidence/nav-mate). On 390x844 viewport with the wipe modal open the badge intercepts pointer events to the nav. Consider adding pointer-events:none on its container or z-indexing the bottom-nav above it.

action_items: (Optional polish) Ensure bottom-nav z-index is above the Emergent badge so users on small screens are never blocked from tapping nav items when modals/footers are visible.
(Optional) Add data-testid to PhoneDialer keypad digits (e.g., dialer-key-8) and to the green Call button (dialer-call-btn) for more robust automated tests.
critical_code_review_comments: security_engine.py is clean: deterministic scoring (per-feature Gaussian similarity), proper HTTP codes (400 missing features, 403 owner verification, 400 missing confirm), async motor usage, MongoDB _id stripped before returning.

OwnerRecognition.trainSamples sends only 3 samples per click — users need to tap 'Capture my behaviour' at least 3 times to cross the MIN_SAMPLES_TO_TRAIN=8 threshold. Consider sending 8 samples in one tap or showing clearer progress.
OWNER_SECRET defaults to '15987' from env var; ensure production deploys override OWNER_RECOVERY_CODE to a private value (currently public in spec which is acceptable for demo).
PhoneDialer and AegisChat lack data-testid attributes on interactive elements — testability gap.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required flows verified on mobile viewport)

test_credentials: Owner recovery code: 15987; Invisible Vault dial code: 8675309; No login required (device_id auto-generated in localStorage 'dm_device_id').
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create per-run TEST_dev_<uuid> device_ids and clean them up via /baseline/reset and DELETE /events fixture teardown. No persistent seed data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use mobile viewport 390x844 (REQUIRED) and click 'Try the Demo →' hero button (not desktop header 'Launch App' which is hidden on mobile and intercepted on desktop). Hide the Emergent badge via JS (document.getElementById('emergent-badge').style.display='none') before clicking bottom-nav items, otherwise it intercepts clicks. The 'Capture my behaviour' button sends 3 telemetry samples per click — need ~3 clicks to trigger baseline training (8 sample min). Backend deterministic scoring is verified: training samples with symmetric jitter around the same feature vector and scoring at that vector gives trust>=0.6; very different features (~5x larger values) give <0.6 and trigger trap_active=true plus a 'critical' access_attempt event.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only an optional UX/z-index polish around the Emergent badge overlapping the bottom-nav on small screens.
